summit-park-blue-ash.chronic.1: Family restrooms are available in three convenient locations throughout Summit Park: – Under the Observation Tower – Beneath the Glass Canopy – Near the Main Playground

Winter Closures (Dec 1 – Jan 31): To protect plumbing during colder months, some restrooms and amenities will be closed: Playground restrooms will be closed for the season. Community Room restrooms will be open only during Ice Rink hours.
woodward-theater.mobility.1: The Woodward Theater is ADA-compliant, including ADA-compliant entry and bathrooms.
woodward-theater.chronic.1: Seating is not always available, though we do offer a limited capacity seating area designated for those with special needs, upon request.
woodward-theater.mobility.3: Take the streetcar to the Hanke Exchange Station (12th & Main) and walk two blocks north on Main.
The Woodward Theater is located one-block south of a Metro stop at the corner Main and Orchard streets.
lindner-family-tennis-center-cincinnati-: Accessible parking is available to those with a disability placard. Place the placard on your rear view mirror and parking attendants will direct you to the appropriate lot. Shuttles are available from public parking lots to gate entrances. To drop someone off at the entry gates, drive to the patron drop-off located by the North Entrance.
The Lindner Family Tennis Center does not have wheelchairs, scooters, or walkers available for rent.
The Lindner Family Tennis Center does not have a wheelchair concierge service to physically assist guests around the grounds.
Food, except in a limited quantity for medical or infant purposes
Re-entry will be permitted after exit scanning on your way out of the grounds.
